Description
Throughout the rich history of the nation of Argentina, there have been many coins that have been produced with a combination of value and collectability. The gold 5 pesos piece is one of the most noteworthy coins. It contains .2334 troy ounces of gold .900 purity that makes it perfect for investors looking to put a moderate investment in coins.
On the obverse side of the coin, you will find a bust of Liberty wearing a Phrygian cap. The obverse side of the coin has the a rendition of the Argentine coat of arms, surrounded by the legend and date. This coin serves the function of being valuable enough to be used for investment options, but also makes a great and beautiful addition to any collection.
Highlights of the Argentina Gold 5 Peso’s Coin (Random Year)
Contains .2334 oz actual Gold weight.
Weight 8.06 Grams
Size and Diameter 1.5 mm*22.12 mm
Each coin will be in at least extra fine condition.
Obverse: Depicts a bust of Liberty wearing a Phrygian cap.
Reverse: A rendition of the Argentine coat of arms, surrounded by the legend and date.
Struck at the Buenos Aires Mint and various other mints.
